response.rationale: The item is final_sale == True (intimates), which triggers RET-012 (priority 100), the highest-priority applicable rule. Although the return is within the 30-day window (RET-007), the final-sale rule dominates. The item is not marked defective (defective == null), so RET-020 does not apply, and no goodwill grant or fraud hold is present. Final-sale items cannot be returned or exchanged.
